title: The Campus Employment Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Work-study and other campus employment listings. The Campus Employment Database lists campus jobs with the employing department, job duties, pay rates, hours, eligibility including work-study requirements, and application instructions where published. Listings carry posting dates and expire when filled or past deadline. The Signature side adds application kits with resume tailoring for campus roles.
capabilities: List campus jobs with duties, pay, hours, and eligibility
Record work-study versus non-work-study requirements
Carry posting dates and expire filled listings
Document application instructions per listing
Provide resume tailoring kits for campus roles
